newsitem.title: UK: Utd Biscuits firm as SBC Warburg rates buy.
newsitem.headline: Utd Biscuits firm as SBC Warburg rates buy.

text.p: Shares in United Biscuits Plc nudged higher on Wednesday as analysts at SBC Warburg repeated a "buy" recommendation on the maker of Penguin biscuits and KP snacks, dealers said.
United Biscuits shares were up 3-1/2p at 208-1/2 by 1132 GMT in modest volume of 675,742 shares.
Analyst Mark Lynch at Warburg said the recommendation came after the recent underperformance of United Biscuits shares.
The stock on Tuesday touched a low of 203p, its lowest since early December last year and well below its year's high of 255p set on March 14.
